description: This file defines the AttributesDeleteRequest class used in the Thingsboard rule engine API for handling attribute deletion requests, including builder pattern for object creation.

classes.name: AttributesDeleteRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to delete attributes within the Thingsboard rule engine, including metadata such as tenant, entity, scope, keys, and callback.

methods.name: scope
